directories.purpose: Repository root metadata, contribution guides, and shared lint/format configs.
directories.designed_for: Project-wide configuration consumed by editors, linters, and contributors.
directories.notes: Root-level tracked files (.editorconfig, .gitignore, .lefthook.yml, lint configs, README, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, SUPPORT) are grouped under '.'.

directories.purpose: Husky git hook entrypoints that delegate to scripts/hooks/.
directories.designed_for: Local git hook execution on commit and pre-commit.
directories.notes: Thin shims; canonical hook logic lives under scripts/hooks/.

directories.purpose: Repository-hosted automation hooks and workflows installed by the AI workflow kit.
directories.designed_for: CI and policy automation, not GitHub Copilot runtime configuration in this OpenCode-only install.
directories.notes: Contains hooks and workflows from governance packs; Copilot adapter files are intentionally absent.

directories.purpose: OpenCode adapter configuration, agents, commands, and skills.
directories.designed_for: OpenCode CLI workflows in this repository.

directories.purpose: JSON schemas validating local artifacts produced by AI tooling.
directories.designed_for: Tooling validation and contract enforcement for session logs and similar artifacts.

directories.purpose: Sanitized historical dotfile backups kept for reference and machine bootstrap.
directories.designed_for: Restoring or comparing prior shell, editor, and tool configuration snapshots.

directories.purpose: Canonical configuration files for terminal, editor, shell, and language tooling.
directories.designed_for: Copying or symlinking into a target machine's user config directories.
directories.notes: Subfolders: ghostty, karabiner, nvim, php, shell, vscode.

directories.purpose: Setup guides, platform-specific runbooks, and reference documentation.
directories.designed_for: Humans bootstrapping a new development environment on macOS, Linux, WSL, or Windows.
directories.notes: Includes platform-scoped subfolders (unix/, windows/) and the AI workflow notes under ai/.

directories.purpose: Installed AI package metadata and policy references used by validators.
directories.designed_for: Local validation of the installed AI workflow kit without requiring the source repository.
directories.notes: Contains package descriptors, catalog, docs, and policies; template source is not installed.

directories.purpose: Code reference corpus, primarily PHP design patterns, principles, and built-in examples.
directories.designed_for: Local study, prompt grounding, and pattern lookup.
directories.notes: Curated example code; not executed by the project itself.

directories.purpose: Shell utilities for local health checks, git hook bodies, and platform setup.
directories.designed_for: Direct invocation by contributors and by Lefthook/Husky hooks.

directories.purpose: PHP test suite covering session-log tooling helpers.
directories.designed_for: Local verification of tools/ai/ behaviour during development.
directories.notes: Run with phpunit or via project task runner.

directories.purpose: PHP CLI utilities supporting AI session logging and validation.
directories.designed_for: Local invocation by contributors and CI for session capture and validation.
directories.notes: Backed by .schemas/ai-session-event.schema.json and tested under tests/php/.
